styleLock.iconSystem: no pictogram matrix and no capsule tags; graphic language is limited to three circular photo insets with a single hairline ring outline in #4A3138, small plain numbered dots 1-2-3 in #93A87E joined to the garment by one hairline leader line, the hairline underline rule, and one blank rounded rectangle button shape; no filled badges, no shields, no seals, no award or certification marks, no document frames
styleLock.presentationRules: three locked scales only: the garment held on a contourless invisible form with a soft contact shadow, the garment laid flat or folded on one plane, and the tight macro reading of one construction edge; identical front orientation and centre-weighted scale between screens, waistband kept horizontal with its tape width and rib direction unchanged, leg-cut and seam placement unchanged, gusset lining shade kept exactly as in the reference, fabric sheen kept as a fine uniform knit jersey with a low satin-like glow only along the crown curve and never rendered as woven, satin or mesh; no face, no hands, no limbs and no body contour ever enter the frame, and no screen mixes the invisible-form scale with the flat-lay scale

no mixed fonts, no serif, script or handwritten lettering

no posed, sexualised or crotch-focused human presentation

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm soft-hand-feel women's intimates commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of dusty-rose seamless field #E7CFC5, cream paper card #FBF5EF, deep terracotta-plum information field #7E4A45, plum-brown ink #4A3138 and one sage-green hairline accent #93A87E; warm soft studio light around 4500K with an oversized diffused key from the upper left through a sheer scrim, a wraparound fill card, a faint bottom bounce, long soft-edged shadows that always ground the garment and one controlled rim highlight along the crown curve; shallow arched niche plus a matte ceramic round plinth disc with a thin brushed metal rim #C6A375 as the only set pieces, cream paper macro boards elsewhere, never a tiered step stage, never a glass dome; rounded humanist sans-serif for every rendered line with one lower-case wide-tracked English sub-label and a hairline underline rule; graphic language limited to circular photo insets with hairline ring outlines, small plain numbered dots with hairline leader lines and one blank rounded button shape, never an icon matrix, capsule tag, shield or seal; garment shown on a contourless invisible form, laid flat or in tight macro at a stable centre-weighted scale, waistband horizontal with its tape width unchanged, gusset lining shade kept, knit jersey rendered truthfully with sheen only along the crown curve; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched graphic styles, no model, no face, no invented certification, composition or size artwork.
